name: E-Commerce Defective Smartphone Refund Denial
raw_input: I ordered a Samsung Galaxy smartphone worth Rs 26,999 on an e-commerce app on 10th November 2024. It was delivered on 14th November. Within 24 hours of opening the box, the screen started flickering with green lines and touch stopped working. I raised a replacement request on 15th November. The app sent a technician for inspection on 21st November. The technician confirmed it is a manufacturing hardware defect and took sign on his job sheet. But on 23rd November, customer support cancelled my return request stating 'The 7-day return window expired on 21st November'. They are telling me to go to an authorized brand service center 40 km away. I paid for a brand new working phone, not a defective phone repaired on day one. I have the invoice, delivery receipt, technician inspection job sheet copy, and chat screenshots.

case_dossier.case_title: Deficiency in Service & Unfair Trade Practice by E-Commerce Platform
case_dossier.summary: Consumer purchased a new smartphone for Rs. 26,999 which had a hardware screen defect within 24 hours. Replacement request raised on Day 1 was denied because company's technician inspection got delayed beyond 7 days.

timeline.event: Screen malfunction observed; replacement ticket raised immediately within 24 hours.
Platform technician inspected device and signed job sheet confirming hardware manufacturing defect.
Customer care unilaterally cancelled return, citing 7-day policy window had elapsed during technician scheduling.

evidence_held: Screenshot of replacement request initiated on 15-Nov-2024 (well within 7 days)
Physical copy / digital photo of Technician Job Sheet signed by company technician certifying 'Hardware Display Defect - DOA (Dead on Arrival)'
Video recording of the malfunctioning screen
evidence_needed: Formal written rejection email from customer support (ticket transcript)
case_dossier.evidence_strength_explanation: Flawless documentation. The technician job sheet itself admits manufacturing defect and return ticket was raised on Day 1.

rights_advice.plain_language_standing: The e-commerce platform's cancellation is completely unlawful and constitutes an 'Unfair Trade Practice' and 'Deficiency in Service' under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. An e-commerce platform cannot use its own operational delays (taking 6 days to send a technician) to run down the clock on your 7-day return policy. Under product liability rules, a consumer is entitled to receive an unblemished, fully functional product, not a brand new phone sent directly for third-party repairs.

governing_laws.relevance: Defines deficiency in service and unfair trade practice (refusing refunds for defective goods).
Holds both marketplace seller and manufacturer liable for manufacturing defects.

governing_laws.act_name: Amazon Seller Services v. Gopal Krishan (NCDRC)
governing_laws.relevance: Marketplace cannot evade consumer obligations by claiming to be just a technology platform.

action_options.title: Escalate to Grievance Officer & National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
action_options.details: Attach technician report to NCH complaint. 75% of e-commerce returns are resolved at this stage.

action_options.title: Serve Formal Pre-Litigation Legal Notice
action_options.details: Send demand notice to company's registered Indian entity and grievance officer.

action_options.title: Online Filing via e-Daakhil Portal
action_options.cost_estimate: Zero court fees for claims up to Rs. 5 Lakhs
action_options.details: File a direct complaint on edaakhil.nic.in in your home district commission without hiring an advocate.

rights_advice.real_lawyer_guidance: Under Section 35 of CPA 2019, consumers can represent themselves in person or online on e-Daakhil. No advocate is required.
rights_advice.disclaimer: ⚠️ Legal advisory tool. For claims exceeding Rs. 50 Lakhs, consult legal counsel.

legal_notice_draft:
# FORMAL LEGAL NOTICE UNDER CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT, 2019
**(SENT VIA REGISTERED EMAIL & SPEED POST)**

**Date:** 25th November 2024

**TO:**
1. Grievance Officer & Customer Escalations,
   [E-Commerce Marketplace India Private Limited]
2. [Seller Entity Name as on Invoice]

**FROM:**
[Consumer Name], Resident of [City, State]
Contact: +91-98XXXXXXXX | Email: consumer@email.com

---

### SUBJECT: FORMAL DEMAND FOR IMMEDIATE REFUND OF RS. 26,999/- FOR DEFECTIVE SMARTPHONE (ORDER ID: #OD-2024-8891) AND COMPENSATION FOR DEFICIENCY IN SERVICE

Sir/Madam,

Please take notice that I, the Complainant, bought a Samsung Galaxy smartphone via your platform for Rs. 26,999/- against Tax Invoice dated 10-Nov-2024, delivered on 14-Nov-2024.

1. **Latent Manufacturing Defect:** Within 24 hours of delivery, the device manifested hardware display failure. A replacement ticket was created on 15-Nov-2024.

2. **Admission of Defect by Your Technician:** Your authorized technical representative inspected the device on 21-Nov-2024 and issued a signed Inspection Job Sheet confirming manufacturing hardware defect.

3. **Unfair Trade Practice:** Your customer support unlawfully rejected the return on 23-Nov-2024, citing policy expiry, disregarding that the delay occurred entirely due to your technician's late visit.

4. **Statutory Breach:** This conduct squarely violates **Section 2(11) (Deficiency in Service)** and **Section 2(47) (Unfair Trade Practice)** of the **Consumer Protection Act, 2019**.

**RELIEF DEMANDED:**
You are hereby called upon to arrange return pick-up and credit the full refund of **Rs. 26,999/-** along with **Rs. 10,000/-** towards harassment within **15 (FIFTEEN) DAYS**, failing which a complaint will be lodged on **e-Daakhil** before the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

**[Consumer Signature]**

sample_roleplay_turn.user_argument: Under Section 2(11) and Section 84 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019, delivering a defective phone and delaying inspection past your return window is a clear deficiency in service and unfair trade practice. I have the technician report confirming hardware fault. I demand an immediate refund or I will escalate to the National Consumer Helpline and e-Daakhil.

opponent_response.opponent_reply: Sir, I understand your concern, but our system automatically locks after 7 days. Once 7 days are over, our portal does not allow refund button. That is why we requested you to visit brand center. However... since you have the job sheet signed by our technician before the 7-day mark, please allow me 24 hours. I will escalate this to my Senior Operations Manager for a special manual refund approval.

coach_evaluation.what_went_well: You caught them red-handed using their own operational delay against you, and quoted both Section 2(11) CPA 2019 and e-Daakhil. The representative immediately pivoted from refusal to offering manual senior escalation!
coach_evaluation.what_to_improve: Give them a strict deadline for their senior callback (e.g., 'by 4 PM tomorrow') and ask for their ticket escalation ID.
coach_evaluation.suggested_next_counter: Please provide your Senior Escalation Ticket ID right now. I will wait until 4 PM tomorrow for confirmation, after which I will submit this transcript to the National Consumer Helpline.
